name: Distance sampler (Extraltodeus original)
plain: Each step first does a Heun-style correction (an Euler trial to the next sigma, a model call there, average the two slopes), then keeps making trial steps with the current blended slope, calling the model at the next sigma each time. All slopes collected so far are combined with per-element weights that favour the ones closest to the others (after normalising each by its norm), and the blend is rescaled to the weighted norm. The registered names use 3 resamples at the start tapering to 1 near the end, slerp-style blending, and plain (not CFG++) slopes: Distance_n also favours elements far from the negative prediction, and Distance_p subtracts half of the previous blended slope's part that is perpendicular to the current one. Compared with ocs-distance (blepping's port): OCS uses raw L1 distances with one global min/max and exponent re_step+2, with no norm rescaling, slerp, negative or perpendicular options. Loading this pack also reloads ComfyUI's k_diffusion sampling module, which can undo other packs' patches of that module depending on load order.
math:
Symbols: x latent; σ, σ' current and next sigma; D(·,σ) model x0; d = (x − D(x,σ))/σ; R resample count.
R_i = clamp(int(R0 r + R1 (1 − r)), min(R0,R1), max(R0,R1)), r = ((σ − σ_min)/(σ_max − σ_min))^{0.5}; Distance*: R0 = 3, R1 = 1.
If σ' = 0, R_i = 0 or outside the step window: Euler x ← x + d(σ' − σ).
Else S = [d]; repeat R_i times: x̃ = x + d(σ' − σ); d̃ = (x̃ − D(x̃,σ'))/σ'; append d̃;
  first pass: d ← (d + d̃)/2; later passes: d ← W(S), append d.
W(S): t_j = S_j/‖S_j‖_F (per channel); c_j = max_j Σ_k |t_j − t_k| − Σ_k |t_j − t_k| (element-wise);
  _n: c_j += |t_j − û| with û the normalised negative x0; weights w_j = (c_j/max c)² / Σ (or softmax(n·c));
  plain: blend = Σ w_j S_j, rescaled to norm Σ w_j ‖S_j‖; slerp (registered names): Σ_j Σ_{k≠j} S_j sin(w_j Ω_jk/(n−1))/sin Ω_jk, Ω_jk = acos(t_j·t_k).
  _p: d ← d − 0.5‖d‖(p̂ − d̂(d̂·p̂)), p = previous blended d.
x ← x + d(σ_down − σ) (+ ancestral noise when eta > 0; RF models use the flow ancestral split).
cfgpp option: slopes use (x − 2D + D_u)/σ, the same substitution as core's alternative Euler CFG++.

props.extra_model_calls: R per step (Distance*: 3 early, tapering to 1; last step none)
props.params: node: resample=3, resample_end=-1, cfgpp=True; advanced adds eta, s_noise, distance_step_eta, use_softmax, use_slerp, perp_step, use_negative, smooth, sharpen and step windows
props.registered_presets: Distance: resample 3→1, slerp; Distance_n: + use_negative; Distance_p: + perp_step; all cfgpp=False
